name: Flock PHP Local Development Environment
free_limit: Free, open-source AGPL-3.0 native PHP/Laravel development environment for Windows and macOS with per-project PHP versions, local .test HTTPS sites, databases, email capture and debugging; no software subscription or account required.
watch_out: Runs on the user's computer, not a free hosted PHP service. Requires supported Windows/macOS and local resources; Flock uses ports 80 and 443 and may conflict with Laragon, Apache or other local stacks. AGPL-3.0 obligations apply when distributing modified software and in applicable network-use scenarios; Linux availability depends on release channel.
